mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_hr_identity_signal(tenant_id,candidate_id,kind,signal_key,quality,shared_contact,conflict_contact) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{candidateId},#{kind},#{signalKey},#{quality},#{sharedContact},#{conflictContact}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quality=VALUES(quality),shared_contact=VALUES(shared_contact),conflict_contact=VALUES(conflict_contact)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT candidate_id FROM ai_hr_identity_signal WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id!=#{incoming} AND signal_key IN #{key} AND candidate_id IN (SELECT id FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at>#{now} AND department_id IN #{d} AND id IN #{c})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_hr_identity_association(id,tenant_id,primary_candidate_id,source_candidate_id,resume_version_id,status,created_at) VALUES(#{id},#{tenantId},#{primaryCandidateId},#{sourceCandidateId},#{resumeVersionId},#{status},#{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status=VALUES(status)
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,primary_candidate_id,source_candidate_id,resume_version_id,status,created_at FROM ai_hr_identity_association WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (primary_candidate_id=#{candidate} OR source_candidate_id=#{candidate}) ORDER BY created_at,id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_hr_identity_signal WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate}
DELETE FROM ai_hr_identity_association WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (source_candidate_id=#{candidate} OR primary_candidate_id=#{candidate})
